convert_swin_pth_to_d2_pkl: convert a pretrained Swin Transformer .pth model file to a Detectron2-compatible .pkl checkpoint file
run_swin_model_conversion_cli: run the CLI script to convert a Swin model checkpoint by passing input pth and output pkl paths as arguments
prepare_swin_weights_for_mask2former: prepare Swin Transformer pretrained weights for use as backbone in Mask2Former by converting to Detectron2 format
extract_model_state_dict_from_pth: extract the model state dict from a Swin Transformer .pth file using torch.load with cpu mapping
create_d2_checkpoint_with_heuristics: create a Detectron2 checkpoint pickle with matching_heuristics enabled and third_party author metadata
